title.narrative: Enhance access to affordable and diversified financing through PES and blended finance to promote sustainable forestry practices and accelerate the clean cooking transition in Rwanda.

description.narrative: GGGI is implementing a 30-month project aimed at designing and piloting innovative financing instruments to accelerate the clean cooking transition in Rwanda. This project is being implemented within the broader 5-year Sustainable Forestry and Efficient Renewable Energy for improved livelihood (SFERE) project implemented by the Luxembourg Development Cooperation Agency which seeks to strengthen the resilience of forest landscapes and dependent communities to climate change in selected districts in Northwestern and Eastern Rwanda.
The overall objective of the 30-month project implemented by GGGI is to enhance access to innovative, affordable, and diversified financing to accelerate the clean cooking transition in Rwanda.
